sql.chasebank.getPaymentsInBatch: select prp.id, prp.project_id, prp.check_number, payment_numbers.total_num_payments, payment_numbers.payment_number, payment_amount as amount, concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) as customer_name, c.mailing_street1, c.mailing_street2, c.mailing_city, (select state.abbreviation from flow.state where state.state = c.mailing_state) as mailing_state, c.mailing_postal_code, c.street1 as customer_street1, c.street2 as customer_street2, c.city as customer_city, (select state.abbreviation from flow.state where state.id = c.state_id) as customer_state, c.postal_code as customer_postal_code from brs.project_rebate_payment prp inner join flow.project p on prp.project_id = p.id inner join flow.contact c on p.contact_id = c.id inner join brs.project_rebate_payment_state state on prp.project_rebate_payment_state_id = state.id inner join (select project_id, count(case when project_rebate_payment_state_id = 1 or project_rebate_payment_state_id = 2 or project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3 then 1 end) :: INTEGER as total_num_payments, count(case when project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3 then 1 end) + 1 as payment_number from brs.project_rebate_payment group by project_id) payment_numbers on payment_numbers.project_id = prp.project_id where prp.project_rebate_batch_id = :batchId
sql.chasebank.saveCheckNumberToPayment: UPDATE brs.project_rebate_payment SET check_number = :checkNumber where id = :paymentId
